UNMANAGED_LOSER_FLAGGED:
Per the run instruction, a position that resolves without a single tv-manage call is flagged rather than reported as clean. This one fired NO management call: the detector returned only window_closing at 04:59, which is after the stop.

Diagnosis: this is NOT a detection gap that better rules would close. The position filled on the bar starting 03:24 and was stopped on the bar starting 03:25 - sixty seconds later, with a best excursion of 3pt against a 23.5pt stop. There is no completed bar between fill and stop at which any management call could have been made. The adverse-excursion trigger that fires at -0.5R would have fired on the same bar that hit the stop.

The real finding is upstream of tier 3: a 23.5pt stop on this setup died in one minute. Management cannot rescue a trade with no time in it, and counting this as an unmanaged loser against tv-manage would misattribute the cause.

That is the 'trailing so tight that ordinary noise takes you out' failure its own contract warns about. It converted a loser into a winner here, but the placement is not obviously correct and is worth his ruling.
